text:
rachel_cs: Noticed several onboarding tickets where CSMs mark 'complete' but customers later report confusion about next steps. We should capture feedback during handoff and feed into playbook heuristics.
omar_manager: Agreed. Low friction capture is key. Suggest a 2-question micro-survey posted to account timeline at handoff: 1) do you understand next steps? (Y/N) 2) any blockers? (short free text).
vikram_data: We can auto-aggregate responses and compute a 'handoff_confidence' score per account. Signal input: survey_yes_pct, avg_free_text_length, followup_requests_count. Thresholds: confidence < 60% -> flag for follow-up.
paula_ops: Implementation idea: Add a playbook step: "Handoff feedback pulse" that triggers webhook to send survey link when CSM clicks "mark ready". Survey results write back to crm.handoff_pulse_response. Add dry_run initial mode.
ben_devex: For the playbook, show a preview modal with the top 5 flagged accounts and allow bulk-assign follow-up tasks. Also include an option to send a short explainer doc if many accounts report confusion.
feedbackbot: survey-run scheduled: cron=0 6 * * FRI, mode=dry_run, sample=recent_handoffs
rachel_cs: UX: in CRM timeline show a compact badge: "handoff confidence: low" with one-click 'request follow-up' that opens a templated email to the customer.
omar_manager: Need audit trail for any automated messages. Record who triggered follow-up, template used, timestamp. Also include a manager approval flow for enterprise accounts.
vikram_data: Metrics to track: % handoffs with survey response, mean confidence, follow-up conversion (did follow-up resolve confusion), and correlation with 90-day NPS. I'll wire up a weekly report.
paula_ops: Steps and ETA:
- Step 1: webhook + survey endpoint + CSV exporter (3 days)
- Step 2: CRM writeback + badge UI (3 days)
- Step 3: playbook modal + bulk assign + templates (2 sprints)
ben_devex: We'll start with dry_run for 2 weeks posting results to #cs-ops for CSM feedback. After that, canary to 200 accounts.
feedbackbot: dry_run export: s3://redwood-cs/handoff-feedback/2026-03-21-dryrun.csv, responses=24, flagged=6
rachel_cs: Owners: paula_ops (impl), vikram_data (metrics), ben_devex (playbook UX), omar_manager (policy). Thanks team :thumbsup:
